packageRules.description: The Minecraft line is changed by hand, together with everything tied to it (see gradle/libs.versions.toml): only newer builds of the 26.2 line are proposed, hotfix lines such as 26.2.1 excluded. Versions look like 26.2.build.7-beta, which is not semver; alpha and beta builds count as pre-releases.
The APIs of the optional plugins. The test servers download the plugins at the same versions, through the same catalog entries.
Must stay on the version ConfigLib depends on: bump it by hand when ConfigLib moves.
Test only, kept on the version the server ships so tests run against the same driver.
